profile_text.body:
PyTorch Image Models (timm) is an open-source project hosted on GitHub under the huggingface organization. It is categorized as a non-profit open-source foundation founded in 2019. The project describes itself as the largest collection of PyTorch image encoders and backbones, with training, evaluation, inference, and export scripts plus pretrained weights. Supported architectures include ResNet, ResNeXT, EfficientNet, NFNet, Vision Transformer (ViT), MobileNetV4, MobileNet-V3 and V2, RegNet, DPN, CSPNet, Swin Transformer, MaxViT, CoAtNet, and ConvNeXt.

Recent updates noted on the project page include Sapiens2 ViTs with EVA and NaFlexViT support, EUPE ViT (DINOv3-style) and ConvNeXt model definitions and pretrained weights, a CSATV2 model with DCT stem and spatial attention, and EfficientNet-X and EfficientNet-H B5 weights from a hyperparameter search comparing AdamW and Muon. The project also describes a dynamic global pool implementation that can select average pooling, max pooling, average plus max, or concatenation of average and max at model creation, with adaptive average pooling as the default.

No litigation is recorded against the project, and no commercial products are associated with it.
